items.title: AI has become a 'non-negotiable', Sam Altman says at G20 summit
items.summary: Big Tech CEOs convened in North Carolina to speak at the G20 summit on Wednesday, laying out the virtues and benefits of AI to world leaders. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley discusses OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman's comments at the event.

items.title: Michael Burry doubles down on his surprising AI bet
items.summary: August was supposed to test whether Burry’s AI bet had merit. The market gave him a very clear answer.

items.title: Micron, SanDisk Lag Tech Rally as China Grabs Memory Market Share
items.summary: Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) and SanDisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) fell Thursday even as technology stocks rallied, after new data showed Chinese memory manufacturers rapidly gaining global market share.Both badly lagged a rally in high-growth technology stocks, with Palantir, SpaceX and Tesla...

items.title: The $1 Trillion Question Hanging Over Palantir Stock
items.summary: Palantir just posted the kind of revenue growth that makes software investors stop mid-scroll, yet the stock sits 8% below its all-time high with insiders selling and a valuation that has skeptics reaching for antacids. Whether that tension resolves as a buying opportunity or a warning sign depends on one number.

items.title: Michael Burry Just Put a $100 Billion Warning on Palantir
items.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Data analytics and artificial intelligence startup Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR, Financials) is back on Michael Burry (Trades, Portfolio)'s radar.  The Big Short investor said Palantir's market valuation, which is around $432 billion, may eventually sink below $100 billion, saying investors are pricing the company more like a high-margin software platform than the business its financial profile suggests.

items.title: Palantir Rallies 7% as PwC Alliance Counters Michael Burry Bear Case, ServiceNow Climbs 5%, Salesforce Gains 3%
items.summary: Michael Burry just renewed his short case against Palantir, and Palantir answered with a major alliance announcement that sent the stock surging. Whether that response actually addresses the receivables quality problem Burry flagged is a different question entirely.

items.title: Why Palantir Stock Bounced Back Today
items.summary: Palantir stock looks expensive, yes, but given its growth rate, is it really overpriced?

items.title: Sadiq Khan to hand over WhatsApp messages in Palantir row
items.summary: Sir Sadiq Khan will hand over his texts and WhatsApp messages as part of an ongoing legal battle with controversial data firm Palantir.
